text.p: Here are the main headlines from the afternoon report of Lithuania's M1 Plus radio station. Reuters has not confirmed these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Algirdas Brazauskas urged legal institutions to investigate vandalism in the country's Jewish cemeteries and to look for ways to protect Jewish heritage.
- The chairman of parliament's committee on health care said health reform has been prepared well but needs further analysis and correction.
- Parliament chairman Vytautas Landsbergis went on holiday until August 16.
